AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_BADGE.title: Exusiai's Badge
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_BADGE.descripti: At the start of each combat, gain {Ammo} [gold]Ammo[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_BADGE.flavor: A Rhodes Island badge. Smiles, good luck, and plenty of ammunition.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_SURPRISE.title: Exusiai's Surprise
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_SURPRISE.descri: At the start of each combat, gain {Ammo} [gold]Ammo[/gold] and {FirepowerPower:diff()} [gold]Firepower[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_SURPRISE.flavor: The warmest blessing deserves the loudest surprise. BOOM!!!!!!!!!!!
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ETCHED_ROUND.title: Etched Round
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ETCHED_ROUND.descriptio: At the start of each combat, gain {FirepowerPower:diff()} [gold]Firepower[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ETCHED_ROUND.flavor: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart; words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_APPLE_PIE_LOGISTICS.des: The first time you play an Attack each turn, gain [gold]Ammo[/gold] equal to the Ammo it spends.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_APPLE_PIE_LOGISTICS.fla: Delivered on time and best enjoyed warm. Ammunition, too.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BOSS_MEDAL.title: Boss's Medal
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BOSS_MEDAL.description: The first time you give a relic [gold]Delivery[/gold] each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BOSS_MEDAL.flavor: Best Boss Medal. Super Boss Medal. Invincible, peerless Boss Medal.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_SERVER.title: Lord-Server
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_SERVER.description: Whenever you obtain a Curse during combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_SERVER.flavor: Connection established. Not every prayer... necessarily receives an answer.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_POCKET_SLOT_MACHINE.des: At the start of each combat, apply {Interference:diff()} [gold]Interference[/gold] to ALL enemies.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_POCKET_SLOT_MACHINE.fla: Compact, portable, and every spin adds a little more gunpowder to the air.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FLUORESCENT_LIGHT.title: Fluorescent Light
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FLUORESCENT_LIGHT.descr: Whenever you play an [gold]Angel[/gold] card, gain {TemporaryFirepowerPower:diff()} [gold]Firepower[/gold] this turn.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FLUORESCENT_LIGHT.flavo: Laterano's light sometimes comes from a humming tube.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FIREPOWER_FM.title: Firepower FM
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FIREPOWER_FM.descriptio: Whenever you spend [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Ammo[/gold] in one turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Firepower[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FIREPOWER_FM.flavor: Channel clear. Coordinates confirmed. Explosions inbound.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_PHOTO_WITH_THE_LORD.des: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ENTRY_PERMIT.title: Entry Permit
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ENTRY_PERMIT.descriptio: Upon pickup, all starting cards still in your deck gain the [gold]Ascension[/gold] enchantment. Cards with an enchantment are unaffected.
When you [gold]Smith[/gold] at a Rest Site, you may choose [blue]1[/blue] additional card to upgrade. Then upgrade [blue]1[/blue] random remaining unupgraded card.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_DRONE.title: Lord Drone
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_DRONE.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} each turn. At combat start, ALL initial enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_SPRAY_CAN.title: Spray Can
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_SPRAY_CAN.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Graffiti[/gold] to your hand.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_CACTUS_TART.title: Cactus Tart
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_CACTUS_TART.description: At the start of each combat, add a random unupgraded card from Exusiai's normal card pool to your hand. It gains [gold]Angel[/gold] for this combat.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_PRISMATIC_WINGS.title: Prismatic Wings
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_PRISMATIC_WINGS.descrip: At the start of each of your first [blue]3[/blue] turns in combat, gain [gold]Soar[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_CONFESS47.title: CONFESS-47
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_CONFESS47.description: At the start of your turn, spend [blue]1[/blue] Gold to gain [blue]2[/blue] Energy and stun [blue]1[/blue] random enemy. Then sleep for [blue]4[/blue] turns.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BEACON_OF_NATIONS.title: Beacon of Nations
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BEACON_OF_NATIONS.descr: Mark a random route to the boss. Combats on that route grant an extra three choice Rare card reward that can include other colors.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_THE_LAW.title: The Law
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_THE_LAW.description: Upon pickup, remove all Curses from your deck. Prevent the next [blue]3[/blue] Curses that would permanently enter your deck.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_PENGUIN_LOGISTICS_ID.de: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} each turn. At the start of each combat, give [gold]Delivery[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] to a random active relic.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_A_FEW_FINE_VINTAGES.des: Upon pickup, gain [blue]2[/blue] Potion slots. At combat start, if a slot is open, gain a random Ursus Beluga, Gaul Chardonnay, or Yan Fenjiu.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BLACK_CARD.title: Black Card
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BLACK_CARD.description: Items and card removal at the Merchant cost [blue]75%[/blue] less.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_MASTER_TAPE.title: Master Tape
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_MASTER_TAPE.description: Upon pickup, gain one three choice Rare card reward from each other compatible character.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ILL_GOTTEN_GAINS.title: Ill-Gotten Gains
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ILL_GOTTEN_GAINS.descri: Upon pickup, gain [blue]3[/blue] random [gold]Transit[/gold] [blue]5[/blue] relics. If you take no damage in combat, your Transit counts do not decrease afterward.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_COMPANY_VAN.title: Company Van
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_COMPANY_VAN.description: Twice per run, you may travel to another unvisited room on your current map row.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_RETURN_TO_SENDER.title: Return to Sender
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_RETURN_TO_SENDER.descri: Upon pickup, lose all non-Starter, non-Transit relics. Receive the same number of random relic rewards; you may skip each one.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_DJ_DECK.title: DJ Deck
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_DJ_DECK.description: During combat, gain a random [gold]Strong Beat[/gold] on odd turns and a random [gold]Weak Beat[/gold] on even turns.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_PRIZED_RECORD.title: Prized Record
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_PRIZED_RECORD.descripti: ALL enemies have [blue]20%[/blue] less maximum HP.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BOSS_BUSINESS_CARD.desc: Upon pickup, add an [gold]Emperor+[/gold] to your deck.
